Add one build-notes commit to each open stage PR, so Entire records a checkpoint per PR.

Context:
- Repo D:\project\neat hacks, stacked PRs #1–#13 (all open). Entire is enabled for Cursor.
- Sources for the notes, in this order: hackathon.md (build log), docs/SPEC.md (stage goals),
  `git log` of each branch, `gh pr view N`, and the past chat transcripts in
  C:\Users\ashih\.cursor\projects\d-project-neat-hacks\agent-transcripts (search them with Grep
  for the stage name and file names; never read them end to end).

Branch → stage → notes file:
- chore/scaffold-quality-gates (#1) → Stage 0 → docs/build-notes/stage-00-scaffold.md
- feat/domain-models (#2, #3) → Stage 1 → docs/build-notes/stage-01-domain.md
- feat/ports-and-company-data (#4) → Stages 2–3 → docs/build-notes/stage-02-03-ports-and-data.md
- feat/llm-client (#5) → Stage 4 → stage-04-llm-client.md
- feat/task-pipeline (#6) → Stage 5 → stage-05-task-pipeline.md
- feat/eval-baseline (#7) → Stage 6 → stage-06-eval-baseline.md
- feat/telemetry (#8) → Stage 7 → stage-07-telemetry.md
- feat/optimizer (#9) → Stage 8 → stage-08-optimizer.md
- feat/iteration (#10) → Stage 9 → stage-09-iteration.md
- feat/lambda (#11) → Stage 10 → stage-10-lambda.md
- feat/report (#12) → Stage 11 → stage-11-report.md
- feat/release (#13) → Stage 12 plus the live runs and fixes → stage-12-release-and-live-runs.md

Each notes file (about 40–80 lines), a summary of how the stage was built with Cursor, not a code dump:
- First line: "Written 2026-10-12 from the chat history and git log, after the stage was built."
- What the stage had to deliver (from SPEC), and the human decisions made (AskQuestion choices).
- How it was built: the main files, the order of work, the commands run
  (make check, pytest, ruff, mypy, gh pr create) and their results.
- What did not work and how it was fixed (lint/mypy/test failures, design changes, blocked commands).
- Final check results and test counts as recorded at the time; say "not recorded" rather than guess.
- Open items it left behind.

Rules:
- Only state what the sources show. Do not invent numbers, results, or events.
- Never write API keys, .env contents, tokens, or names of people from fixtures/raw. Refer to
  secrets as "the LiteLLM key" or "the neatlogs key".
- Do one branch at a time, bottom up: git switch <branch>, write the file, git add only that file,
  git commit -m "docs(notes): how stage N was built". When Entire asks to link the commit to the
  session, answer yes.
- After the first commit, run `entire checkpoint list` and confirm a checkpoint exists. If not, stop
  and tell me (run `entire doctor`).
- Leave .entire/ and .cursor/hooks.json untracked while switching branches. At the end, on
  feat/release, commit .entire/settings.json, .entire/.gitignore and .cursor/hooks.json as
  "chore: enable Entire".
- Do not merge, rebase, or force-push. When all commits are done, show me the list of commits and
  checkpoints and ask before pushing.
I'll add one evidence-based build-notes commit per open stage PR, starting from the sources and working bottom-up so Entire can record a checkpoint on each branch.
The build log has to stay evidence-based, so I’ll pull the spec, the hackathon log, each PR, and the matching chat history before writing any notes.

"""One-off extractor for build-note evidence. Not part of the project."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path

PATH = Path(
    r"C:\Users\ashih\.cursor\projects\d-project-neat-hacks"
    r"\agent-transcripts\1c1ad557-05b9-4cd3-86a5-225d44f7bf4a"
    r"\1c1ad557-05b9-4cd3-86a5-225d44f7bf4a.jsonl"
)

KEYS = (
    "docs_then_run",
    "you_pick",
    "two_commits",
    "haiku_sonnet",
    "pr_now",
    "run_smoke",
    "us-east-1",
    "costwise-qualify",
    "pr_tag",
    "n28_b15",
    "fix_saving",
    "no_run",
    "selected",
    "answers",
)


def main() -> None:
    for index, line in enumerate(PATH.open(encoding="utf-8"), 1):
        if not any(key in line for key in KEYS):
            continue
        obj = json.loads(line)
        role = obj.get("role")
        # Skip the AskQuestion prompt lines themselves when they only define options.
        content = obj.get("message", {}).get("content", [])
        kinds = [c.get("type") for c in content if isinstance(c, dict)]
        if "tool_use" in kinds and role == "assistant":
            continue
        text_bits: list[str] = []
        for item in content:
            if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("type") == "text":
                text_bits.append(item.get("text", "")[:1500])
        blob = "\n".join(text_bits)
        if not blob:
            blob = line[:800]
        print(f"===== L{index} {role} kinds={kinds} =====")
        print(blob[:1800])
        print()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""One-off extractor for build-note evidence. Not part of the project."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path

PATH = Path(
    r"C:\Users\ashih\.cursor\projects\d-project-neat-hacks"
    r"\agent-transcripts\1c1ad557-05b9-4cd3-86a5-225d44f7bf4a"
    r"\1c1ad557-05b9-4cd3-86a5-225d44f7bf4a.jsonl"
)

PHRASES = (
    "you chose",
    "you asked",
    "your choice",
    "as you",
    "Stage 5",
    "Stage 6",
    "failed",
    "mypy",
    "ruff",
    "blocked",
    "PLR",
    "C901",
    "error",
)


def text_of(obj: dict) -> str:
    content = obj.get("message", {}).get("content", [])
    parts: list[str] = []
    for item in content:
        if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("type") == "text":
            parts.append(item.get("text", ""))
    return "\n".join(parts)


def main() -> None:
    for index, line in enumerate(PATH.open(encoding="utf-8"), 1):
        obj = json.loads(line)
        if obj.get("role") != "assistant":
            continue
        text = text_of(obj)
        if not text:
            continue
        low = text.lower()
        if not any(phrase.lower() in low for phrase in PHRASES):
            continue
        # Keep only paragraphs that mention a phrase.
        kept: list[str] = []
        for para in text.split("\n\n"):
            plow = para.lower()
            if any(phrase.lower() in plow for phrase in PHRASES):
                kept.append(para.strip())
        if not kept:
            continue
        print(f"===== L{index} =====")
        print("\n---\n".join(kept)[:2200])
        print()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path

PATH = Path(
    r"C:\Users\ashih\.cursor\projects\d-project-neat-hacks"
    r"\agent-transcripts\1c1ad557-05b9-4cd3-86a5-225d44f7bf4a"
    r"\1c1ad557-05b9-4cd3-86a5-225d44f7bf4a.jsonl"
)


def text_of(obj: dict) -> str:
    content = obj.get("message", {}).get("content", [])
    parts: list[str] = []
    for item in content:
        if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("type") == "text":
            parts.append(item.get("text", ""))
    return "\n".join(parts)


NEEDLES = (
    "timed out",
    "unrelated",
    "BROKEN",
    "include_external",
    "ezwinports",
    "gh pr create",
    "word boundary",
    "task-0001",
    "auto-review",
    "not the team",
    "license",
    "plugin",
    "429",
    "you chose",
    "Not yet",
    "credentials",
    "v0.1.0",
    "two attempts",
)


def main() -> None:
    out = Path("_extract_out2.txt")
    with out.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        for index, line in enumerate(PATH.open(encoding="utf-8"), 1):
            obj = json.loads(line)
            if obj.get("role") != "assistant":
                continue
            text = text_of(obj)
            if len(text) < 80:
                continue
            hits = [needle for needle in NEEDLES if needle.lower() in text.lower()]
            if not hits:
                continue
            handle.write(f"===== L{index} hits={hits} =====\n")
            # paragraphs containing a needle
            for para in text.split("\n"):
                if any(needle.lower() in para.lower() for needle in NEEDLES):
                    handle.write(para[:400] + "\n")
            handle.write("\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Written 2026-10-12 from the chat history and git log, after the stage was built.

## What Stage 0 had to deliver

`docs/SPEC.md` asks for an empty, green Python 3.12 project with every quality gate wired: the package skeleton, ruff, mypy strict, import-linter, pytest with the network disabled, coverage gates, the file-length and TODO scripts, a Makefile, pre-commit config, `.env.example`, `.gitignore`, the three Cursor rules, an empty `docs/open-verifications.md`, and one placeholder test. Acceptance is `make check` exiting 0, and one deliberate broken import that makes `make layers` fail, then reverted.

The human asked to build one stage at a time and to wait for approval after each stage.

## How it was built

Cursor wrote the scaffold in one pass and stopped. The files include `pyproject.toml`, `uv.lock`, the Makefile, `scripts/check_file_length.py`, `scripts/check_todos.py`, the empty `src/costwise` tree, `tests/unit/test_scaffold.py`, the three `.cursor/rules` files, and the two source documents copied in as `docs/SPEC.md` and `docs/stack-and-integration-plan.md`. Example `config/*.yaml` files were left for Stage 2, when the loaders exist.

GNU Make was not on the machine at the start. A winget search found ezwinports Make 4.4.1, already installed, and that is what `make check` used. The project is pinned to Python 3.12 because the default interpreter was 3.13.

`make check` exited 0. pytest: 1 passed (`tests/unit/test_scaffold.py` imports every scaffold package). Coverage: overall 100% (gate 80), domain 100% (gate 90), services 100% (gate 90). Those packages were docstring-only, so coverage saw 0 statements. No `TODO(VERIFY)` items.

This directory was not a git repo yet. The chat gave the PowerShell commands to init `chore/scaffold-quality-gates`, commit, add `origin`, and open the pull request. Git log on this branch:

- `75cbda4` Initial commit (remote `main`, `LICENSE` only)
- `9daf2c3` `chore: scaffold project with quality gates`
- `0c88b80` `Merge remote main into scaffold branch`

PR #1, "chore: scaffold project with quality gates", is open against `main`: https://github.com/ashihams/Vamonos-AI/pull/1

## What did not work

- import-linter 2.15 will not enforce the external I/O ban unless `include_external_packages = true`. That flag was set so the httpx, boto3, and yaml contract actually runs. Ruff's assert rule (`S101`) is ignored under `tests/` only. The stage report calls both adjustments, not weaker gates.
- A `costwise.domain` import of `costwise.services` made `make layers` fail with "domain is pure BROKEN". A bare `TODO` made `scripts/check_todos.py` fail. Both were reverted, as the spec asks.
- GitHub refused the first pull request: this branch and `main` had no commits in common, because the scaffold was created with `git init` and `main` held only `LICENSE`. `origin/main` was merged with `--allow-unrelated-histories`, then `gh pr create` opened PR #1.
- `entire enable` had not been run.

## Left open

No verification items. Stage 1 had not been started, and the human still had to approve Stage 0. The example config files were not created.
